messages:
Nina: quick heads-up 15min review: on mobile portrait the console's right-hand details panel overlaps the Instances table and creates a horizontal scroll. Can we switch to an inline accordion or a bottom sheet on small widths?

Tom: repro on iPhone SE 2nd gen. Steps: Console > Deployments > Instances, portrait. The header truncates and action icons are hard to hit.

Elena: looks like our sidebar collapse breakpoint is 640px but table becomes cramped at ~480px. We should pick a consistent mobile breakpoint. Suggest we use 520px as the cutover.

Ravi: preference: inline accordion keeps list position but can cause large reflows with virtualization. Bottom sheet keeps list stable and is discoverable. Also: bottom sheet needs focus trap + escape handling for keyboard users.

Nina: tiny copy change: change "Details" to "View details" on the compact button so screen readers convey purpose.

Tom: provisional CSS fallback for immediate patch if we need it: 
```css
.table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; }
.table { min-width: 680px; }
```

Elena: would rather avoid horizontal scroll on phones. Plan: <=520px use bottom sheet; 521-760px use inline expand; >760px keep side panel.

AccessibilityBot: checklist reminder: focus management, aria-modal for sheets, announce expand/collapse with aria-live, 44px min touch targets, respect prefers-reduced-motion.

Ravi: design motion note: use translateY on sheet with will-change: transform and avoid layout paints. Also test that swipe-to-dismiss doesn't conflict with iOS back-swipe.

Nina: can we A/B test bottom sheet vs inline expand? Metrics: time-to-open-details, error taps, task completion for quick edits.

Elena: I'll put both variants in Figma and include keyboard flows + an a11y checklist. ETA tomorrow EOD. Uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi789/mobile-views (notes in file).

Tom: QA: add tests for reduced-motion and keyboard close. Also re-check color contrast for status labels; the current gray fails AA in dark mode.

Nina: assigning follow-up DES-3520 to Elena and engineering handoff to Ravi. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
